_comment: The base loot pool (#196): the plain version of every category, findable from life one. Every listed type is tier 0 and never unlock-gated. Anything not listed is tier 0 only if it scores below UnlockManager.UNLOCK_SCORE_THRESHOLD (cheap junk, herbs, food, plain helms and boots); everything else is tier 1+ by score and arrives through the unlock roll. A template may also set "tier" itself in its own JSON entry.
